summary: @servicetitan/anvil-token 0.4.3 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 0.4.3 of this scoped design-token package adds a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun v1.3.13 GitHub release, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bun-cjs bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated string-array via a `WV8StW` shuffle routine, thousands of numeric constants, hex-named identifiers, a large substitution alphabet, and `with` statements that prevent parsing by standard Node tooling). The payload is executed under the freshly-fetched Bun runtime rather than Node, which evades Node-based install-time scanning. Prior versions of the package through 0.4.0 are a pure design-token library with no preinstall hook, no bundled runtime download, and no `math_init.js`; the CHANGELOG does not mention any of these additions. The package.json for 0.4.3 also has an empty description and no repository or author fields. The shape — a scoped legitimate library suddenly adding an alternate-runtime dropper of a large obfuscated blob at install time — is consistent with a compromised release running attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
